title: Require an untouched final test set before recipe promotion
narrative: A leading candidate must pass a separate untouched final test before it can be released, and that test must not be used as a tuning signal. Promotion is refused when no final-test result is supplied, when the result did not come from a held-out evaluator, or when it failed; only a passing held-out result opens the gate. The same rule guards both the research workflow and the recipe catalog's active pointer. Evaluator held-out labelling already exists (`taloneth_insp_evaluator_compose`). Tracks MH-SR-07[^insp-sr-07].
implementation: `require_held_out_final_test()` and `FinalTestGateError` in `evaluator.py`; `ResearchLab.promote(candidate, final_test=...)` enforces it whenever `EvalProtocol.held_out_protected` (the default); `GraphTemplateRegistry.promote_with_final_test()` applies it before moving the active pointer and attaches the held-out result as an evaluation. Plain `GraphTemplateRegistry.promote()` stays an ungated pointer move for hosts that run their own gate.
validation: Kind `recipe_final_test_gate`. Hard expects refusal for a missing, non-held-out, and failed result for both the research lab and the registry, promotion for a passing held-out result, an unmoved pointer after refusals, and that an unprotected protocol skips the gate. Unit tests: `tests/test_final_test_gate.py`.
